</figure>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1376">
<div class="ce_text col-12_xl-9 block">
<h1>Rental Trailers at the "Wulfener Hals"</h1>
<h2>Get a taste of the exciting camping atmosphere on the Baltic Sea</h2>
<p>On your marks, vacation, go! Our approximately 100 rental trailers at the &ldquo;Wulfener Hals&rdquo; on Fehmarn are all set and ready for you to turn into your vacation home for wonderful days by the sea. Arrive and relax right away: whether right on the beachfront, near the beach, or with your four-legged friend. As a caravan renter, you&rsquo;ll of course have access to all the vacation park&rsquo;s facilities, including the pool and hot tub.</p>
<p><strong>Let's set off on your RV adventure!</strong></p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article section-primary block" id="article-1374">
<h2 class="ce_headline center">
Book your rental camper online now at Wulfener Hals.</h2>

</source></source></source></source></source></picture>
</figure>
</div>
<div class="ce_text block">
<h2>Dethleffs Season-Camper Rental Trailers</h2>
<p>Exactly what you&rsquo;ve been looking for: In collaboration with the RV manufacturer Dethleffs, we&rsquo;ve developed a travel trailer that sets new standards in comfort and design. A spacious layout, beautiful fabrics, a kitchenette, and a shower in a separate room in the awning, plus a large TV with a mount that swivels outward. Of course, you&rsquo;ll find this model in our lineup as well.</p>
<p><a href="season-camper">About the Season Campers</a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article full-width marg-top block" id="article-1378">
<div class="text-bild-links">
<div class="ce_text block">
<h2>With us, camping meets plenty of comfort</h2>
<p>All trailers are permanently connected to the sewer and water systems and feature a toilet, washroom, and heating; some also have a shower. Choose from a selection of modern rental trailers, all of which come equipped with a fabric or hard-sided awning that includes a floor. Inside the awnings, you&rsquo;ll find a table, chairs, lounge chairs, and a 160-liter refrigerator. How much space do you need for the perfect vacation? Some of our trailers can accommodate up to 2 adults and 3 children. And you can request all the items your little ones need right when you make your reservation. That way, you won&rsquo;t have to bring travel cribs, high chairs, and other essentials from home.</p>
<p><a href="weitere-mietwohnwagen">More Rental Trailers</a></p>
</div>
<div class="ce_image block">
<figure class="image_container">
<picture>
<source srcset="assets/images/a/Mietwohnwagen%20M11%20Hobby%20Prestige%20650KMFe%20200905-7272cc93.webp 1x, assets/images/e/Mietwohnwagen%20M11%20Hobby%20Prestige%20650KMFe%20200905-3c0b628e.webp 1.25x" media="(min-width: 48em)" type="image/webp" width="2000" height="900">

</section>
<section class="mod_article section-primary block" id="article-1379">
<div class="grid">
<div class="ce_text col-12_md-7 block">
<h2>Look forward to a cozy atmosphere</h2>
<p>You won&rsquo;t be missing a thing when it comes to the tasteful amenities: From bedding, satellite TV, and a flat-screen TV to a microwave or oven in the kitchen and even a queen-size bed in some of the RVs&mdash;it&rsquo;s all there! The sleeping area in the rental RVs is typically separated by a door or sliding door. Even during the cooler months, your vacation home is warm and cozy. All rental trailers are equipped with a gas convection heater. The gas system also provides hot water in the trailer.</p>
</div>
<div class="col-12_md-5">
<div class="ce_text textbox block">
<h2>Camping Vacation with Your Dog</h2>
<p>If you'd like to bring your pet, please contact us before booking. Dogs &amp; other pets are allowed in some rental RVs under certain conditions.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
